items.exampleEn: She loves cooking gourmet meals for her friends.
items.exampleZh: 她很愛為朋友做精緻的美食料理。
items.glossZh: 美食的、精緻料理的；美食家

items.exampleEn: In the old western film, the hero walks into a noisy saloon.
items.exampleZh: 那部老西部片裡，主角走進一間吵鬧的酒館。

items.exampleEn: My neighbor is a connoisseur of fine tea.
items.exampleZh: 我的鄰居是品茶的行家。

items.exampleEn: We ordered a plate of succulent grilled shrimp.
items.exampleZh: 我們點了一盤鮮嫩多汁的烤蝦。

items.exampleEn: The climbers carried provisions for five days.
items.exampleZh: 登山者帶了五天份的糧食。

items.exampleEn: Spicy food can wake up your tastebuds.
items.exampleZh: 辛辣的食物能喚醒你的味蕾。

items.sentenceEn: Only a true connoisseur can tell these two coffees apart.
items.sentenceZh: 只有真正的行家才分辨得出這兩種咖啡。

items.audioEn: We booked a table at a gourmet restaurant for her birthday.
items.audioZh: 我們為了她的生日，在一家高級美食餐廳訂了位。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼訂了高級餐廳？

items.sentenceEn: The roast chicken was tender and succulent.
The ship ran out of provisions after three weeks at sea.
items.sentenceZh: 那艘船出海三週後，就把糧食吃完了。

items.stemEn: As a cheese ____, he can tell where each cheese was made.
items.stemZh: 身為起司行家，他分辨得出每一種起司的產地。

items.stemEn: This ____ steak was so good that I finished it in minutes.
items.stemZh: 這塊牛排鮮嫩多汁，好吃到我幾分鐘就吃完了。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, our company held a dinner for clients in the restored saloon of an old hotel. The chef, known as a connoisseur of local ingredients, prepared a gourmet menu with six small courses, each served on a different plate. The highlight was a succulent piece of slow-cooked pork that delighted everyone's tastebuds. Some guests joked about the extravagance of the evening, but the boss smiled and said the hotel had offered a fair price. After dinner, the chef explained that he buys all his provisions directly from farmers every morning.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們公司在一家老飯店修復後的大廳裡宴請客戶。主廚以精通在地食材聞名，準備了一份有六道小菜的精緻美食套餐，每道菜都用不同的盤子盛裝。最精彩的是一塊慢火燉煮、鮮嫩多汁的豬肉，讓大家的味蕾都很滿足。有些客人開玩笑說這頓晚餐太奢侈了，但老闆笑著說飯店開的價格很公道。晚餐後，主廚說明他每天早上都直接向農夫採買所有食材。

questions.questionZh: 這頓晚餐最精彩的是什麼？
options: 主廚親自上台介紹每一道菜
請員工到大城市的市場採買
每天早上向農夫直接採買

items.promptZh: 這條街上有很多高級美食餐廳。
referenceEn: There are many gourmet restaurants on this street.
This street has a lot of gourmet restaurants.
rubricZh: gourmet 當形容詞，表示「美食的、精緻料理的」（例如 gourmet restaurants 等）
「很多」可寫，例如 many、a lot of 等

items.instructionZh: 用 tastebud（可用複數 tastebuds）造一個句子，說說一種讓你味蕾很開心的食物。
referenceEn: Fresh mango always makes my tastebuds happy.
My tastebuds love anything with lemon in it.
rubricZh: tastebud 是可數名詞，表示「味蕾」（例如 my tastebuds、the tastebuds 等）
句子要說到你自己喜歡的食物

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：晚宴辦在「老飯店修復後的大廳（saloon）」，主廚與菜單都沒提到餐廳，老闆卻說 "the restaurant had offered a fair price"，前後場地不一致；建議改 "the hotel had offered a fair price"。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 the hotel had offered a fair price，中譯同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 overdraft／paywall／endorsement 與「As a cheese ___」語意完全無關，一眼排除（§11-26）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 干擾項換成同屬餐飲情境的已教名詞 tastebud、saloon、batter，只看英文時代入 As a cheese ____ 都不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：題幹 succulent … so juicy 語意重複
自查修正：自查：my uncle 譯「叔叔」多加了父系資訊
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：gourmet 當形容詞，表示「美食的、精緻料理的」（例如 gourmet restaurants 等）／「很多」可寫，例如 many、a lot of 等
